def transform(g):

 for i in range(len(h)):
  for j in range(len(h[i])):
   if h[i][j]!=0: continue
   if i<2: h[i][j]=1
   elif i==2: h[i][j]=4
   elif j<2: h[i][j]=1
   elif j==2: h[i][j]=4
   else:
    # repeat the row's five-cell motif, anchored at a known value
    vals=[(k,h[i][k]) for k in range(len(h[i])) if h[i][k]!=0 and k>=3]
    # nearest known point congruent modulo 5
    candidates=[(abs(k-j),v) for k,v in vals if (k-j)%5==0]
    h[i][j]=min(candidates)[1] if candidates else next(v for k,v in vals)
 return h
